_about: The reference: the user's two videos of a plush reindeer (C:/Users/meets/Downloads/reindeer.mp4, a 6 s turntable of it sitting; reindeer_walking.mp4, 6 s of the same plush standing and walking on four legs, 464 x 688). Frames are kept local (%TEMP%/figrefs/reindeer, tools/reference_frames.py), never in the repo. Fractions of the height H, floor to antler tip, measured by eye on a 25 px grid. Standing: walking 5.0 s (near side, about 3/4: H = 520 px from the hoof at y 575 to the antler at 55) and 0.0 s (front, camera low and close: tops read high, so eye heights differ, 0.51 H side and 0.63 H front; the side's is used, nudged). Head width and eye spacing from the sitting 0.0 s front frame and the walking 0.0 s front frame, which agree. The droid is an original design inspired by it: no brand tag, no copied geometry.
